title: Plan review and adaptive revision action
summary: Review displays authored human mini-plans and one primary action that changes from approval to revision when steering is present.

assertions.description: Architecture, Decisions, Risk, and Verification each contain planner-authored structured header/description items, not headings synthesized from prose fragments.
Exactly one Start-run-styled primary button says Approve run while steering is empty and Revise plan when steering is nonempty.
The steering editor wraps multiple lines and submitting revision closes review into visible planning activity without approving execution.
